purpose: Independent practice of C3.2 (alter IF-THEN code).
student_learning_goal: I can alter IF-THEN code and describe the effect.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can alter IF-THEN code and describe the effect.
header.character_watermark: Inspector If in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Change the condition in each code. Predict the new outcome for the given input.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Four condition-alteration tables.

image_placeholders.description: Four condition-alteration tables in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Each: 'Original: ___', 'Altered: ___', 'Input: ___', 'New outcome: ___'. Sample originals: 'IF >10 THEN BIG', 'IF even THEN clap', 'IF =5 THEN star', 'IF >20 THEN HIGH'. Header 'Alter Condition:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_COND: keywords (alter, condition) name what the tables ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Each altered condition must produce a verified outcome.

parts.student_instructions: Change the action in each code. Predict the new outcome.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four action-alteration tables.

image_placeholders.description: Four action-alteration tables in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Each: 'Original: ___', 'Altered: ___', 'Input: ___', 'New outcome: ___'. Sample originals same as Part 1. Header 'Alter Action:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_ACTION: keywords (alter, action) name what the tables ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Each altered action must produce a verified outcome.

parts.student_instructions: Swap the TRUE and FALSE branches in 2 codes. Describe the effect.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Two branch-swap descriptions.

image_placeholders.description: Two branch-swap descriptions in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. Each: 'Original: ___', 'Swapped: ___', 'Effect: ___'. Header 'Swap Branches:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_SWAP: keywords (swap) name what the slots ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Effect description must show that opposite-branch outcomes are produced.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, chain TWO alterations on the same code and predict the cumulative effect.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 worksheet practices C3.2 altering. Watch for alteration-doesn't-matter trap — children who carry old outcomes to altered code. Part 3 is a TRANSFER probe: present an UNFAMILIAR multi-conditional code (e.g., 'IF >10 THEN BIG; ELSE IF =10 THEN MID; ELSE SMALL') that children did not see at any station. They must alter ONE branch and re-trace — verifies that alteration generalises beyond the lesson's specific code patterns.
